fact: A cross-sectional survey of 482 persons with disabilities in Nairobi's 11 sub-counties (published 2026) found 23.4% had ever used digital government services despite 99.6% ICT and internet access.
title: Baseline Survey on Digital Accessibility of Government Services for Persons with Disabilities in Nairobi County, Kenya, 2021
publisher: East African Journal of Arts and Social Sciences
